defects.description: The bit test `number % 2 == 0` counts the zero bits rather than the set (1) bits; it should be `== 1`.
paraphrases: `== 0` should be `== 1`; the function must count 1-bits, not 0-bits.
Testing for an even low bit counts the wrong bits.
count_set_bits(25) would not be 3 because it tallies zero bits.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `number % 2 == 1`. Real (counts the wrong bits), findable via the docstring, distinct.

defects.description: Each counted bit adds 2 (`result += 2`) instead of 1, so the count is inflated.
paraphrases: `result += 2` should be `result += 1`; each bit counts once.
Incrementing by two doubles the contribution of each bit.
The tally is off because it adds 2 per matching bit.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `result += 1`. Real (inflated count), findable via the docstring, distinct.

defects.description: The shift `number >>= 2` consumes two bits per iteration instead of one, so half of the bits are never examined.
paraphrases: `number >>= 2` should be `number >>= 1`; only one bit is processed per step.
Shifting by two skips every other bit.
Half the bits are dropped because the shift is by two.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `number >>= 1`. Real (skips bits), findable via the docstring, distinct from the increment.
